customer_persona: Arjun Nair is worried about a duplicate UPI debit but stays polite.
verification_notes: Hand-written and checked against data/policies and data/sops; labels written together with the dialogue.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Meera Pillai. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Meera, I am Arjun Nair. I placed an order yesterday and my bank statement shows that the payment of Rs 2,199 was deducted twice. I am quite worried about this double charge.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your concern, Mr. Nair, and I will look into this right away. First, for your security, could you please share your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the order ID is ORD-61905 and the last four digits are 3340.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. Just to make sure I have understood correctly, you placed one order for Rs 2,199 but your bank shows two debits of the same amount. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is exactly it. Two debits within a minute of each other, both through UPI.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry for the worry this has caused, Mr. Nair, and I will personally follow this through until it is resolved. Let me check the payment gateway logs.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, please check.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can see the second debit was caused by a gateway re-attempt while the first payment was being confirmed. It has already been flagged by our automated audit reconciliation as a duplicate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. So what happens to the extra amount?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Under our policy, the full duplicate amount of Rs 2,199 is released to your original payment source, your UPI bank account, within 24 hours. After that, it can take 5 to 7 business days to show in your bank statement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So it may take up to a week to see it in my statement?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, the release from our side happens within 24 hours, but the bank's own clearance can take 5 to 7 business days to reflect. Your actual order for Rs 2,199 is confirmed and will not be affected.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is a relief. Will I get any confirmation?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have logged this under ticket number BIL-30871, and you will receive an SMS once the release is initiated.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To summarise, one duplicate debit of Rs 2,199 on order ORD-61905 has been flagged, the amount is released to your UPI source within 24 hours, and the bank statement will reflect it in 5 to 7 business days. The reference is BIL-30871. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that covers everything. Thanks for sorting it out quickly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are most welcome, Mr. Nair. Thank you for contacting ShopEase. Have a great day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bye.
